scope: Existing material website presentation; original papers not reread for figure interpretations. Broader curation remains paused.

collection.qualification: Documentation categories describe fields in linked records, not completeness of the original paper or readiness for all training tasks. Reference coordinates do not establish measured sample coordinates.

molecules.qualification: Computed reference conformers; salts, mixtures and ambiguous identities retain component/identity qualifications. No atom labels on molecular figures.

unit_cells.qualification: Independent phase-qualified reference/comparator models, plus explicitly scoped framework/average structures. Components displayed in parallel; unknown occupancies remain unknown.

morphology.qualification: Exact sample contexts and separate figure contexts remain distinct. Projected outlines are interpretations, not measurements. Unresolvable boundaries and non-microscopy graphics are excluded from new cartoons.
